caseName: Jinks v. Richland County, South Carolina
caseNameFull: Jinks v. Richland County, South Carolina, Et Al.

opinions.text: Sup. Ct. S. C. [Certiorari granted, ante, p. 972.] Motion of amici curiae Alabama et al. and respondent Richland County to allow Alabama et al. to participate in oral argument as amici curiae and for divided argument denied.
